author: Kif Leswing
title: It's fun and easy to see the first iPhone apps you ever downloaded from the Apple App Store (AAPL)
text: It's fun and easy to see the first iPhone apps you ever downloaded from the Apple App Store (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jul 10, 2018, 5:55 pm 12 pts Apple's App Store — the first and still only way to install software on iPhones and iPads — first launched 10 years ago exactly, as of Tuesday. This has gotten a lot of people thinking about their first iPhone (or iPod Touch) and the apps they installed. The app landscape was far different in…
